name: Snake Plant
description: A hardy, upright plant with stiff sword-like leaves. Tolerates low light and infrequent watering, great for beginners.

name: Spider Plant
description: Produces long arching leaves and baby plantlets on runners. Easy to grow and purifies indoor air.

name: Peace Lily
description: Glossy dark green leaves with elegant white flowers. Thrives in low light and signals thirst by drooping.

name: Boston Fern
description: A lush, feathery fern that loves humidity. Adds a soft, tropical feel to any room.

name: ZZ Plant
description: Waxy, dark green leaves on a plant that survives weeks without water. Nearly indestructible.

name: Golden Pothos
description: A trailing vine with heart-shaped leaves splashed with gold. Grows fast in almost any light.

name: Areca Palm
description: Feathery fronds that give a breezy, tropical look indoors. Prefers bright, indirect light.

name: Rubber Plant
description: Large, glossy burgundy-green leaves on a sturdy stem. Grows into an impressive floor plant.

name: Boxwood
description: Dense evergreen shrub popular for hedges and topiary. Handles shaping and shade well.

name: Hydrangea
description: Large, showy flower clusters that can change color with soil pH. A classic garden shrub.

name: Rose Bush
description: Classic flowering shrub with fragrant blooms in many colors. Needs full sun and regular pruning.

name: Marigold
description: Bright orange and yellow blooms that are easy to grow and help repel garden pests.

name: Sunflower
description: Tall stems topped with large golden flower heads that track the sun across the sky.

name: English Lavender
description: Fragrant purple flower spikes on silvery foliage. Drought-tolerant and attracts pollinators.

name: Hosta
description: Shade-loving perennial grown for its broad, textured leaves rather than flowers.

name: Japanese Maple
description: Ornamental tree prized for its delicate, deeply lobed leaves that turn brilliant red in autumn.

name: Moth Orchid
description: Elegant arching stems of long-lasting flowers in white, pink, or purple shades.

name: Tropical Hibiscus
description: Large, trumpet-shaped flowers that bloom for a day but keep coming all season.

name: Bird of Paradise
description: Bold banana-like leaves and striking orange-blue flowers resembling a bird in flight.

name: African Violet
description: Compact plant with fuzzy leaves and clusters of purple, pink, or white flowers. Blooms year-round indoors.

name: Amaryllis
description: Grows from a bulb into a tall stalk topped with enormous trumpet-shaped flowers.

name: Bougainvillea
description: Vigorous vine covered in vivid papery bracts in pink, purple, or orange. Loves full sun.

name: Petunia
description: Trumpet-shaped flowers in a rainbow of colors, perfect for pots and hanging baskets.

name: Camellia
description: Glossy evergreen shrub with rose-like blooms that flower in cooler months.

name: Mexican Snowball
description: Rosette-forming succulent with pale blue-white leaves. Extremely low maintenance.

name: String of Pearls
description: Trailing succulent with tiny bead-like leaves that cascade over pot edges.

name: Aloe Vera
description: Thick, spiky leaves filled with soothing gel, useful for minor burns and skin care.

name: Golden Barrel Cactus
description: Round, ribbed cactus covered in golden spines. A striking desert statement piece.

name: Jade Plant
description: Thick, glossy oval leaves on woody stems. Said to bring good luck; very easy to care for.

name: Zebra Haworthia
description: Small rosette succulent with white striped bumps on dark green leaves.

name: Burro's Tail
description: Trailing succulent with plump, teardrop-shaped leaves that resemble a braided tail.

name: Bunny Ears Cactus
description: Flat, paddle-shaped pads covered in tiny bristles, growing in a rabbit-ear pattern.

name: Sweet Basil
description: Fragrant culinary herb with tender green leaves, essential for pesto and Italian cooking.

name: Peppermint
description: Fast-spreading aromatic herb used in teas, remedies, and cooking for its cooling flavor.

name: Rosemary
description: Woody, needle-leafed herb with a piney aroma, popular in roasted dishes and traditional remedies.

name: Ashwagandha
description: A medicinal shrub used in Ayurvedic medicine, valued for its adaptogenic roots.

name: Chamomile
description: Daisy-like flowers dried for a calming, apple-scented herbal tea.

name: Thyme
description: Low, wiry herb with tiny aromatic leaves, a staple seasoning in many cuisines.

name: Lemongrass
description: Tall, citrus-scented grass used in teas and Southeast Asian cooking.

name: Holy Basil (Tulsi)
description: Sacred herb in Indian tradition, brewed as tea and used for its purported immune benefits.

name: Juniper Bonsai
description: A classic evergreen bonsai with dense, scale-like foliage, ideal for wiring into dramatic shapes.

name: Ficus Bonsai
description: A forgiving, indoor-friendly bonsai with small glossy leaves and thick aerial roots.

name: Chinese Elm Bonsai
description: A popular beginner bonsai with fine branching and small serrated leaves.

name: Jade Bonsai
description: A thick-trunked succulent bonsai style, very tolerant of neglect and low humidity.

name: Japanese Maple Bonsai
description: Delicate, deeply cut leaves that turn brilliant red and orange in autumn.

name: Pine Bonsai
description: A traditional bonsai species with long needles, prized for its rugged, aged appearance.

name: Bougainvillea Bonsai
description: A flowering bonsai that produces vivid papery bracts when given plenty of sun.

name: Azalea Bonsai
description: A flowering bonsai covered in vibrant blooms each spring, popular for display shows.

name: String of Hearts
description: Delicate trailing vine with heart-shaped, marbled leaves on thin wiry stems.

name: Hanging Pothos
description: A trailing vine version of the classic pothos, perfect for shelves and hanging baskets.

name: English Ivy
description: Fast-growing trailing vine with lobed leaves, often grown in hanging pots or as ground cover.

name: Trailing Spider Plant
description: Arching leaves and cascading plantlets make this a natural fit for a hanging basket.

name: Hanging Burro's Tail
description: Long, trailing strands of plump succulent leaves that drape beautifully from a hanging pot.

name: Hanging Boston Fern
description: Full, feathery fronds that spill gracefully over the sides of a hanging planter.

name: Philodendron Micans
description: Velvety, heart-shaped leaves with a shimmering bronze-green sheen on trailing stems.

name: Dischidia Million Hearts
description: Tiny round succulent-like leaves densely packed along thin trailing stems.

name: Terracotta Pot (8-inch)
description: Classic breathable clay pot that helps prevent overwatering. Fits most medium plants.

name: Copper Watering Can
description: A long-spout watering can for precise, gentle watering of indoor and patio plants.

name: Garden Trowel
description: A hand-held digging tool for potting, transplanting, and weeding.

name: Pruning Shears
description: Sharp bypass shears for clean cuts when trimming stems, leaves, and small branches.

name: Organic Plant Fertilizer
description: A balanced, slow-release fertilizer to keep houseplants and garden beds healthy.

name: LED Grow Light
description: A compact full-spectrum light that supplements sunlight for low-light indoor plants.

name: Plant Mister Spray Bottle
description: A fine-mist spray bottle for raising humidity around ferns and tropical plants.

name: Gardening Gloves
description: Durable, breathable gloves that protect hands while potting, pruning, and weeding.
